Message:
ath10k: add cleanup in ath10k_sta_state()

If 'sta->tdls' is false, no cleanup is executed, leading to memory/resource
leaks, e.g., 'arsta->tx_stats'. To fix this issue, perform cleanup before
go to the 'exit' label.
